messages.text: BL-1660 🎵 in progress — local_ollama_pack_shape_lib.sh's bl1142_pack_config feeds awk through a pipe and exits awk at the first match under set -o pipefail, so printf dies of SIGPIPE whenever awk stops reading first - 57 of 400 classify calls exited 141 under load on main 2026-09-20 (2 of 400 idle; every run on a body larger than the pipe buffer), the property lane reads it as a flake (QA 2026-09-19, QA and coder 2026-09-20) and the launch gate can refuse a mono-router pack: the first match is taken without an early exit, and a body larger than the pipe buffer pins the status
